title: Whitley Strieber's uncle worked with General Exon at Wright Field
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Whitley Strieber's uncle worked with General Exon at Wright Field, about 1940s at Wright Field, Ohio, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the writer Whitley Strieber, author of the book Communion about his reported encounters with strange beings, talks about an uncle who worked very closely with a General Exon at Wright Field, a military airfield in Ohio, in the 1940s. As told, this would tie Strieber's own family to the military world his story touches.
